**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 2 (the growth tool).** `bun nv scaling` in `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts` measures three ladder kinds — `run`, `compile`, `fmt` — each a `Measure` there; the module doc says what each one measures and is the home of the ramp, the bounds, `EXPECT`, `KINDS` and `AREAS`. Tests: `tools/nv/test/scaling.test.ts`.

**`nvs check --count`** prints `compile: tokens= nodes= names= exprs=` on stderr, and `nvs run --count` prints the same line with `ir=` before the program runs (`Checked::count_line` in `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs`; `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md` § *nvs check*). Test: `check_count_prints_what_each_phase_produced` in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/check_command.rs`.

**`--iterations --check`** is not reliable yet. Two full sweeps of the same code gave 952 flat and 2 grow, then 954 flat and 0 grow. Counts are the same on every run, so the two "grows" were the clock repeating under machine load. A bench whose counts settled but whose clock grew twice now goes to callgrind, and callgrind decides. No full sweep has run with that change; the driver's next sweep is the first.

**Ladders:** `arrays/sort.nvs` (run, flat), `compiler/functions.nvs` (compile, flat: every phase slope 1.00), `fmt/classes.nvs` (fmt, **grows**: the clock of `nvs fmt --check` goes up 3.6x, 4.5x, 4.9x per doubling, 28 s for a 400 KB file on the debug build). So `bun nv scaling --check` fails on the fmt ladder until the formatter is fixed, and `--areas` names 19 of 22 areas without a ladder. `docs/perf/performance-review.md` does not exist yet (Stage 4).

items.text: **The `lsp` kind** — `nvs lsp` over stdio, driven the way `tests/lsp/` drives it (open, edit, completion, hover, references) on the document the ladder prints; clock only, like `fmt` (`FMT` in `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:420`). Dispatch at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:1707`. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.

**The `serve` kind** — `nvs serve` with a load the tool sends; per-request counts and peak memory, flat per request (goal prose Stage 2, *The bounds*). `MEASURES` at `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:427`. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.

backlog: **`nvs fmt` is quadratic** in file size (`benches/scaling/fmt/classes.nvs`). `print::print` in `crates/nvs-fmt/src/print.rs:67` is linear; the cause is in one of the stages it calls (`indent`, `brace`, `space`, `tokens`, `modifiers`, `imports`), not found yet. Stage 5 fix; owner doc `docs/perf/performance-pass.md`.
Stage 3: a ladder for each of the 19 areas `bun nv scaling --areas` names.
